```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(moderndive)
library(fishualize)
```

A model using <https://github.com/PsyTeachR/introdataviz> where x axis is the joint number, and y axis is the score we use something like the example <https://psyteachr.github.io/introdataviz/advanced-plots.html>

```{r}
all <- read.csv("final.csv")
all <- all|>
  group_by(Model)
```

```{r}
ggplot(all, aes(x = Joint, y = rmse, fill = Model)) +
  introdataviz::geom_split_violin(alpha = .5, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = .05, alpha = .8, fatten = NULL, show.legend = FALSE) +
  #stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "pointrange", show.legend = F, 
               #position = position_dodge(.175)) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "Joint", labels = c("0")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "RMSE",
                     #breaks = seq(200, 800, 100), 
                    limits = c(0, 500)) +
  scale_fill_fish_d(option = "Antennarius_commerson", name = "Model")+
  theme_minimal()

```
